results.title: Zombie Reddy 2 NXT LVL: Teja Sajja returns with a 'Bigger, Badder and Bloodier' Zombie-verse; Shanaya Kapoor, Upendra join cast; watch
results.description: When a successful film returns with a sequel, expectations naturally rise- but Zombie Reddy 2 NXT LVL appears intent on taking its predecessor's madness to an entirely new scale. On Teja Sajja 's birthday, the makers officially unveiled the title and dropped a high-energy announcement video, promising a zombie-verse that is “BIGGER, BADDER & BLOODIER.” Related Story: Zombie Reddy 2 announcement on Teja Sajja’s birthday! Will Prasanth Varma pass the directorial baton for the sequel? Teja Sajja Returns to the Zombie-verse Titled Zombie Reddy 2 NXT LVL- Dead or Alive, the sequel brings Teja Sajja back as the franchise's central character. The glimpse teases zombies taking over Hyderabad, with the iconic Charminar featuring prominently, suggesting that the new instalment will expand the scope considerably beyond the original film's setting. The 2021 Zombie Reddy, directed by Prasanth Varma, stood out for combining zombie horror with comedy, action and a distinctly Telugu setting. The sequel now promises to retain that eccentric identity while mounting the story on a much larger canvas. Shanaya Kapoor, Upendra Join the Mayhem The sequel adds significant star power with Shanaya Kapoor and Kannada superstar Upendra joining Sajja. Kapoor, known for Tu Yaa Main, will make her Telugu and South Indian cinema debut as the female lead, while Upendra has been confirmed in a pivotal role. Their inclusion gives the franchise a broader cross-industry appeal. Prasanth Varma Passes the Directorial Baton While Prasanth Varma created and directed the original, he will not return as the sequel's director. Instead, Suparn S. Varma takes charge, with Prasanth remaining attached as the creator and writer. Suparn, known for projects including The Family Man Season 2 and Rana Naidu, will bring his own storytelling approach to the zombie spectacle. The screenplay is being handled by Hussain Dalal, Abbas Dalal, Prasanth Varma and Suparn S. Varma, with Subbu K credited for dialogues. Gowra Hari Handles the Music Adding to the technical team is composer Gowra Hari, known for HanuMan and Mirai. Abhinandan Ramanujam serves as cinematographer, while Vijay Velukutty handles editing and Banglan takes care of production design. Seven Languages, 2027 Release Produced by T.G. Vishwa Prasad and Krithi Prasad under People Media Factory, Zombie Reddy 2 NXT LVL is planned as a multilingual release in Telugu, Hindi, Tamil, Kannada, Malayalam, Nepali and Japanese in 2027. Must Check: Jai Hanuman: Teja Sajja clears the air on exit rumours from PVCU, Rishab Shetty-led film With a new director, bigger cast, expanded setting and a promise of more blood-soaked zombie chaos, the sequel is clearly aiming to transform the quirky original into a larger-scale franchise. The zombie-verse is back- and this time, it is truly NXT LVL.
